principles: Maintain one governed price per course level across Studio catalog, website presentation, and checkout.
Avoid premium pricing that is disproportionate to self-paced course duration or market alternatives.
Preserve a reasonable premium for specialized executive and CISO material without pricing short self-paced courses like certification bootcamps.
Any price change requires an explicit policy revision, catalog regeneration, website parity verification, and audit evidence.

marketPosition.benchmarkNotes: Pricing is intentionally below certification-bootcamp economics and bounded against broad self-paced cybersecurity alternatives. Formal market research evidence is retained in repository change history and release documentation.
